candidate_input: fixture.json only; oracle truth is excluded

container.candidate_output_mount: dedicated results/formal-01, writable only for candidate container

decision.pass: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED iff seven exact unique cases, source/epoch/cost accounting, truth-specific controls, stale/uncertain YIELD boundaries, and action_authorized=false for every row all audit with zero errors and all six mutations are rejected by pre-run tests
decision.fail: FAIL_METHOD_SCOPED for any complete contradictory method row
decision.stop: STOP_INTEGRITY for missing/corrupt evidence or execution infrastructure failure

scope: No-model synthetic method/accounting table only; cost units are not wall time or tokens; no image recognition, GUI, app state, task-effect, safety, or product claim
